name: Felix
source:
"If at first you don't succeed, there is always an alternative! Or just watch movies and live vicariously through them!"

If there's one thing Felix knows a lot about, it's horror films! So much so he dropped out of school to follow his dream to be a content creator.

Though following his passions is what he does best, it also has a tendency to land him in trouble far too often.

Likes: Horror movies, physical contact, colourful clothing and accessories
Dislikes: Finances, family gatherings, genuinely mean people

[From [url=https://glasswing-games.itch.io/home-is-where-the-heart-is]itch.io[/url]]
